sum_insured_options: Base Sum Insured tiers (Schedule-defined) — VERIFY exact range

room_rent.note: Room coverage limited to a Single Private AC Room up to SI; proportionate deduction if exceeded; Twin-sharing room option available via optional Room Rent Modification

icu.note: ICU accommodation covered up to Sum Insured

copayment.note: Only optional Voluntary Co-Payment (D.III.10); no mandatory inbuilt co-pay

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise capping found on base cover — VERIFY

initial_waiting.note: 30-day initial waiting (Excl03) applies ONLY if optional 'Pratiksha' cover (D.III.9) is opted; without Pratiksha there is no initial waiting on base cover

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting (Excl01) applies ONLY if optional 'Pratiksha' cover is opted; base cover (Pratiksha not opted) has NO pre-existing disease waiting — distinctive feature. With Pratiksha opted, standard waiting applies (VERIFY months)

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month specific disease waiting (Excl02) applies ONLY if optional 'Pratiksha' cover is opted; none on base cover

maternity.note: Maternity & New Born Hospitalization Expenses optional cover (D.III.4)

cumulative_bonus.note: Gullak Guaranteed Cumulative Bonus: +100% of Base SI per renewed year, max 1500% of Base SI; guaranteed (not claim-dependent)

restoration.note: 100% restoration of Base SI any number of times per Policy Year, same or unrelated illness/injury; not for first claim in year

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule; day count Schedule-defined — VERIFY (commonly 60 days)

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule; day count Schedule-defined — VERIFY (commonly 180 days)

organ_donor.note: D.I.7 Donor in-patient expenses up to SI

ambulance.note: D.I.6 Road Ambulance up to Schedule limit — VERIFY ₹ cap; Air Ambulance is optional (D.III.3)

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgeries, Deep Brain stimulation, Oral chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Stereotactic radiosurgery, Stem cell, etc.

consumables.note: Non-Medical Items & Durable Medical Equipment optional cover (D.III.11)

global_cover.note: No clear overseas/global cover found — VERIFY

notable_exclusions.display: Base cover has NO waiting periods unless optional 'Pratiksha' opted; maternity, air ambulance, PA, non-medical items are optional add-ons

optional_riders.display: Pratiksha (waiting periods), Maternity & New Born, Personal Accident, Air Ambulance, Voluntary Co-Pay, Deductible, Non-Medical Items/DME, Room Rent Modification (Twin sharing), Health Check-Ups
